stem.en: A nurse dons a fit-tested disposable N95 respirator before entering an airborne-infection isolation room. OSHA requires the nurse to perform a ________ each time the respirator is put on.
stem.zh: 护士在进入空气传播隔离病房前戴上已完成适合性测试的一次性 N95 呼吸器。OSHA 要求每次戴上呼吸器时都进行________。

stem.en: A nurse will irrigate a deep wound. Facility policy classifies the procedure as likely to produce splashes of blood or body fluid but not aerosols. Complete the PPE plan.
stem.zh: 护士将冲洗一个深部伤口。机构政策将该操作归类为可能产生血液或体液飞溅，但不会产生气溶胶。完成个人防护装备计划。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should wear {{1}} and protect the face with {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应穿戴{{1}}，并使用{{2}}保护面部。

options.zh: 手套和防液体渗透隔离衣

options.en: a surgical mask and eye protection
an N95 respirator without eye protection
options.zh: N95 呼吸器但不戴护目装备

stem.en: A nurse is preparing to perform open tracheal suctioning. Facility policy requires sterile technique and anticipates possible respiratory-secretion splash. Which actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 护士准备进行开放式气管吸痰。机构政策要求采用无菌技术，并预计可能有呼吸道分泌物飞溅。哪些措施适当？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Reuse the catheter for the next pass after it rests on the bed
options.zh: 导管放在床上后继续用于下一次吸引

options.en: Use sterile gloves to handle the suction catheter
options.zh: 使用无菌手套操作吸痰导管

options.en: Wear a mask, eye protection, and a gown for splash protection
options.zh: 佩戴口罩、护目装备和隔离衣以防飞溅

options.en: Use clean gloves to reposition the sterile catheter tip
options.zh: 用清洁手套重新调整无菌导管尖端

options.en: Perform hand hygiene before preparing the equipment
options.zh: 准备设备前进行手卫生

options.en: Keep the catheter from touching nonsterile surfaces before insertion
options.zh: 插入前避免导管接触非无菌表面

stem.en: During medication preparation, a nurse observes a colleague use the same syringe to enter a multidose vial after the syringe was used to inject a client. The colleague then places the vial back in the shared medication refrigerator. Complete the bow-tie diagram.
stem.zh: 在配药过程中，护士看到同事用刚给患者注射过的同一支注射器再次穿刺多剂量药瓶，然后把药瓶放回共用药品冰箱。完成蝴蝶结图。

condition.en: Possible contamination of a shared multidose vial
condition.zh: 共用多剂量药瓶可能被污染

condition.en: Loss of medication potency from refrigeration

condition.zh: 常规药品浪费记录不符

actions.en: Report the event to infection prevention and the appropriate leader
actions.zh: 向感染预防部门和相应负责人报告事件

actions.en: Remove and quarantine the vial from further use
actions.zh: 停止使用并隔离该药瓶

actions.en: Replace the needle and continue using the same syringe
actions.zh: 更换针头后继续使用同一支注射器

actions.en: Return the vial to circulation if the solution looks clear
actions.zh: 如果药液看起来清澈就继续使用

parameters.en: Whether the vial remains within its labeled expiration date
parameters.zh: 药瓶是否仍在标示有效期内

parameters.en: Which clients received doses from the vial after the unsafe entry
parameters.zh: 不安全穿刺后哪些患者使用过该药瓶

parameters.en: Whether the vial contains a preservative

stem.en: A clinic applies respiratory hygiene and cough etiquette to every person with signs of respiratory infection at the point of entry. Classify each action as part of this standard-precautions approach or not part of it.
stem.zh: 某门诊在入口处对所有有呼吸道感染迹象的人实施呼吸卫生和咳嗽礼仪。判断每项措施是否属于这种标准预防措施。

rows.en: Ask about cough and respiratory symptoms during arrival screening
rows.zh: 到达筛查时询问咳嗽和呼吸道症状

rows.en: Offer a mask to a coughing person who can tolerate it
rows.zh: 向能够耐受的咳嗽者提供口罩

rows.en: Provide tissues and hand-hygiene supplies near the entrance
rows.zh: 在入口附近提供纸巾和手卫生用品

rows.en: Seat symptomatic persons apart from others when space permits
rows.zh: 空间允许时让有症状者与他人分开就座

rows.en: Delay urgent assessment until the cough has stopped
rows.zh: 等咳嗽停止后再进行紧急评估

stem.en: Floodwater has entered the hospital's ground floor and is rising. The emergency plan directs staff to move clients and essential services from lower floors to predetermined safe floors within the same building. This movement is called ________ evacuation.
stem.zh: 洪水已进入医院一楼并持续上涨。应急计划要求工作人员把患者和关键服务从较低楼层转移到同一建筑内预定的安全楼层。这种转移称为________疏散。
